MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

2. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 13

4. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

6. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

8. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 48

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 8

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 13

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
